kitEvidence.formula:
Kassadin teleports to a nearby location, dealing [80 / 95 / 110 + (0.5) × AP + 0.02 × AbilityResource(default, statFormula=default)] magic damage.

Each subsequent use of this Ability within the next [15] seconds doubles the Mana cost and deals an additional [35 / 45 / 55 + (0.07) × AP + 0.01 × AbilityResource(default, statFormula=default)] magic damage. The cost and damage increases can stack up to [4] times.

builds.name: Nether Blade: point-blank AP stab
builds.summary: Explore a high Nether Blade active magic bonus result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high Nether Blade active magic bonus result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 W active bonus is 150 + 0.8 AP magic damage. The passive 25 + 0.1 AP and physical delivery must be distinguished from that active, not automatically stacked by reading two tooltips. Mana supports earned Seraph AP but is not a direct W coefficient; Lich Bane is an alternative proc slot.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, maximum selected rank unless overridden, game minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 max HP, 100 armor, 50 MR; no allied buffs, dragons or elixirs. Owner full HP. No unearned permanent stacks. Read actual AD/AP/HP and resists before the hit. Item/rune proc damage is separate; no scoring after target death. One active W attack; legally transformed Seraph, no R damage or passive attack repeated twice. Target starts at 30% HP; prior champion combat 0s. Gathering Storm fixed at minute 30; Absolute Focus only above 70% owner HP.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Kassadin's Attacks deal an additional [25 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage.

Active: Kassadin charges his blade, causing his next Attack to deal [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage and restore [4 / 4.5 / 5 / 5.5 / 6]% missing Mana, increased to [20 / 22.5 / 25 / 27.5 / 30]% against champions.
